treatment_summary.value: Before thalidomide, the HA20 group (2 patients) received no glucocorticoids; one of the two received an immunosuppressive agent (hydroxychloroquine), not attributed to a patient (Table 1). Study regimen: thalidomide 1-2 mg/kg nightly (max 50 mg) for 12 months. Age at baseline (start of thalidomide) 11.50 years. Anorexia and nausea at 25 mg/d (1.0-1.5 mg/kg), resolved after dosage reduction. Treated with thalidomide alone by the end of 1-year follow-up (cases 4, 12, 13). HA20 disease severity: Mild at 3 months before and at baseline; disease-free activity at 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. Efficacy in HA20 at 12 months 100%.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: genetic diagnosis of monogenic AID (study inclusion criterion); TNFAIP3 variant listed in Additional file 2
